units.source_text: 夕雾生于高贵之家，尽可享受世间一切荣华，但他作出之诗，却表明刻苦求学之大志，而且每句都富有意味。

en.t: Yugiri was born into a noble family and could fully enjoy every glory the world had to offer, yet the poems he composed showed his great resolve to study diligently, and every line was rich with meaning.

units.source_text: 诗中引证晋人车胤在萤光下读书及孙康映着雪光读书等典故。

en.t: In the poems he alluded to such stories as the Jin scholar Che Yin studying by the light of fireflies and Sun Kang reading by the reflected light of snow.

units.source_text: 时人无不赞誉，认为此诗即使传入中国，也不失为优秀之作。

en.t: Everyone at the time praised them, saying that even if these poems were carried to China, they would still count as excellent works.

units.source_text: 至于源氏内大臣的大作，精美自不待言。

en.t: As for the grand compositions of Genji, the Inner Minister, their refinement goes without saying.

units.source_text: 其中热诚地歌咏着父母爱子之心，读者无不感动流泪。

en.t: In them he warmly sang of the love parents feel for their child, and every reader was moved to tears.
People everywhere talked of them, each eager to read them for themselves.

units.source_text: 作者女流之辈，才疏学浅，不宜侈谈汉诗。

en.t: The author, being only a woman with little talent and shallow learning, ought not to speak at length about Chinese poetry.
To avoid needless detail, I leave it all aside.
